review_candidates.description: L2 Cloud Administrator Location: Indonesia (On-site) Experience: 5–8 Years Job Overview We are seeking an experienced L2 Cloud Administrator to manage, maintain, and support enterprise multi-cloud infrastructure, with a primary focus on Tencent Cloud and additional exposure to GCP, AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Huawei Cloud. The successful candidate will be responsible for cloud infrastructure administration, operational support, infrastructure automation using Terraform, cloud security management, and FinOps operations. The role requires strong hands-on technical expertise in managing cloud compute, databases, storage, networking, and security services while ensuring operational stability, cost efficiency, and regulatory compliance. The candidate will also be responsible for enforcing Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) governance through GitLab CI/CD pipelines, ensuring that all cloud provisioning and configuration changes are performed through approved Terraform workflows rather than manual cloud console changes. Key Responsibilities 1. Cloud Infrastructure Administration Administer and maintain Tencent Cloud infrastructure, including compute instances, managed MySQL/PostgreSQL databases, MongoDB, Redis, and cloud storage services. Perform day-to-day L2 administration, monitoring, troubleshooting, and maintenance of cloud infrastructure. Manage cloud resources, configurations, availability, and performance across enterprise environments. Support database availability, storage capacity management, backup monitoring, and recovery operations. Administer and support multi-cloud environments covering Tencent Cloud, GCP, AWS, Azure, and Huawei Cloud. Ensure cloud infrastructure availability, reliability, and operational performance in accordance with agreed service levels. 2. Multi-Cloud Operations and Management Manage and support cloud infrastructure across Tencent Cloud, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Huawei Cloud. Perform L2 troubleshooting and incident resolution involving cloud compute, storage, databases, and networking. Support cloud resource provisioning, configuration management, patching, and capacity planning. Maintain secure and reliable connectivity between cloud platforms and on-premises infrastructure. Support multi-cloud networking components, including VPN, cloud interconnect, and SD-WAN connectivity. Coordinate with cloud service providers and internal infrastructure teams for complex technical escalations. 3. Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) and Terraform Governance Implement and maintain Terraform-based Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) for cloud infrastructure provisioning and configuration management. Manage Terraform modules, state files, configuration templates, and infrastructure deployment workflows. Ensure all cloud infrastructure provisioning and changes are executed through approved GitLab-hosted CI/CD pipelines. Enforce the governance requirement that manual or ad-hoc cloud console provisioning and configuration changes are not permitted. Support GitLab pipeline execution, deployment validation, change approvals, and configuration version control. Conduct infrastructure configuration reviews and ensure compliance with established IaC standards. Troubleshoot Terraform deployment failures and resolve configuration or pipeline-related issues. 4. Cloud Security and Access Management Implement and maintain cloud security controls across multi-cloud environments. Administer and support Check Point CloudGuard for cloud security posture management and workload protection. Manage Cloudflare WAF and CDN configurations to protect applications and optimize content delivery. Support CyberArk Privileged Access Management (PAM) for secure access to cloud administrative accounts. Enforce role-based access control (RBAC), least-privilege principles, and secure credential management. Monitor cloud security configurations and address identified vulnerabilities and compliance gaps. Coordinate with security teams to investigate and remediate cloud security incidents. 5. FinOps and Cloud Cost Optimization Operate and maintain cloud FinOps platforms to monitor and manage cloud expenditure across multiple cloud providers. Track cloud consumption, resource utilization, budget allocation, and overall cloud spending. Configure and monitor cloud budget alerts and cost thresholds to prevent unexpected expenditure. Identify cost optimization opportunities through resource rightsizing, idle resource identification, and utilization analysis. Prepare periodic cloud cost and usage reports for client governance and management reviews. Work with infrastructure and application teams to implement cloud cost optimization recommendations. Support financial transparency and cost accountability across cloud environments. 6. Regulatory Compliance and Governance Ensure cloud infrastructure and workloads comply with Indonesia's Personal Data Protection Law (UU PDP). Support data residency requirements and ensure sensitive data is stored and processed in accordance with applicable regulations. Enforce appropriate cloud access controls, data protection measures, and security configurations. Maintain cloud configuration documentation, audit records, and compliance evidence. Support periodic security assessments, compliance reviews, and regulatory audits. 7. L2 Incident, Problem, and Change Management Provide Level 2 operational support for cloud-related incidents involving compute, databases, networking, storage, and cloud security. Investigate and troubleshoot infrastructure issues to restore services within agreed SLA timelines. Perform root cause analysis (RCA) for recurring and major cloud incidents and recommend preventive actions. Manage cloud infrastructure changes through approved ITSM and change management processes. Coordinate with L3 engineering teams, cloud service providers, and application support teams for complex escalations. Maintain incident records, troubleshooting documentation, and knowledge base articles. Proactively identify recurring operational issues and recommend service improvements. 8. Monitoring, Reporting, and Documentation Monitor cloud infrastructure health, resource utilization, availability, and performance. Develop and maintain cloud operational dashboards and infrastructure performance reports. Support cloud cost and usage reporting through tools such as Spotfire or Power BI. Maintain technical documentation, cloud architecture records, operational procedures, and configuration inventories. Support integration with IT Asset Management (ITAM) and Configuration Management Database (CMDB) platforms for cloud asset lifecycle tracking. Participate in operational reviews and provide regular updates on cloud service performance, incidents, risks, and optimization activities. Required Skills and Qualifications 5–8 years of experience in cloud infrastructure administration, cloud operations, or cloud engineering support. Strong hands-on experience administering Tencent Cloud , particularly compute, managed MySQL/PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, and cloud storage services. Working experience with at least one or more additional cloud platforms, including GCP, AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Huawei Cloud. Strong practical knowledge of Terraform and Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) governance. Experience managing GitLab CI/CD pipelines for automated infrastructure provisioning and deployment. Understanding of cloud networking, including VPN, interconnect, routing, and connectivity troubleshooting. Hands-on exposure to cloud security solutions such as Check Point CloudGuard, Cloudflare WAF/CDN, and CyberArk PAM. Knowledge of FinOps practices, cloud cost management, budget monitoring, and resource optimization. Understanding of Indonesia's UU PDP, cloud data residency requirements, and access governance. Experience in L2 incident management, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and change management. Good understanding of cloud security, availability, backup, disaster recovery, and operational best practices. Strong analytical, problem-solving, documentation, and communication skills. Good-to-Have Skills Hands-on experience with AWS EC2, RDS, and S3 administration. Experience managing Azure Virtual Machines (VMs) and Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS). Experience managing Huawei Cloud infrastructure alongside Tencent Cloud. Knowledge of Spotfire or Power BI for cloud cost, consumption, and utilization reporting. Experience integrating cloud platforms with ITAM/CMDB solutions for asset discovery and lifecycle management. Experience with multi-cloud network connectivity, including VPN, cloud interconnect, and SD-WAN. Familiarity with cloud monitoring, automation, and configuration management tools. Relevant cloud certifications such as Tencent Cloud, AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud certifications. Key Technical Competencies Tencent Cloud Infrastructure Administration Multi-Cloud Management (GCP, AWS, Azure, Huawei Cloud) Terraform and Infrastructure-as-Code Governance GitLab CI/CD Pipeline Administration Cloud Security and Compliance Check Point CloudGuard Cloudflare WAF and CDN CyberArk Privileged Access Management Cloud FinOps and Cost Optimization Cloud Database and Storage Administration Cloud Networking and Connectivity L2 Incident and Problem Management Indonesia UU PDP Compliance Cloud Monitoring and Performance Management If you are interested, please send your updated resume to intannurazrin.hanafiah@prideglobal.com OR WA to +6011-45308817
